title: Warm Crispy Canadian Corn Bake
description: A malty, crispy Canadian dish featuring yellow masarepa, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal, this Warm Crispy Canadian Corn Bake is a delicious monsoon treat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yellow masarepa, malty flour, and salt.
Add the melted unsalted butter, large eggs, grated cheddar cheese, and chopped fresh cilantro to the bowl, mixing until well combined.
Gradually add the water to the bowl, stirring until a thick batter forms.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake the corn bake in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the edges are crispy.
Remove the corn bake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the Warm Crispy Canadian Corn Bake hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
